_rationale.waterColor: midpoint of v1 [0.28,0.48,0.36] and v2a: refraction tint warm olive-tan: what the eye sees through the top metre is sediment-coloured, not green-blue
_rationale.waterScatteringColor: midpoint of v1 [0.18,0.25,0.2] and v2a: main fix: v1 (0.18, 0.25, 0.20) is darker than vanilla (0.19, 0.33, 0.39), so the deep channel goes near black; a brighter olive-brown body colour reads as silt
_rationale.absorptionDistance: midpoint of v1 3.8 and v2a: turbid: the colour comes from the lit silt, not from dark depth; a 0.5 m creek still transmits ~80 %, so the clear-creek rule holds
_rationale.maxRefractionDistance: midpoint of v1 2 and v2a: turbid water shows little bed distortion
_rationale.ambientScattering: midpoint of v1 0.5 and v2a: second main fix: ambient light lifts the body colour so deep water is not darkened (Barrier Island vanilla uses 0.8)
_rationale.heightScattering: midpoint of v1 0.2 and v2a: slightly brighter wave crests on a silty surface
_rationale.displacementScattering: midpoint of v1 0.1 and v2a: more light scattered in displaced (moving) water: turbidity
_rationale.directLightTipScattering: midpoint of v1 0.4 and v2a: sunlit crests glow a little more than v1 (0.4)
_rationale.directLightBodyScattering: midpoint of v1 0.35 and v2a: sunlight lights the suspended silt in the body: warm, opaque river
_rationale.foamAmount: midpoint of v1 0.9 and v2a: more foam and turbulence at the falls, rapids and spillway
_rationale.causticsIntensity: midpoint of v1 0.6 and v2a: turbid water: weak caustics, only in the clear shallows
_rationale.smoothnessClose: midpoint of v1 0.92 and v2a: softer highlights: less mirror
_rationale.smoothnessDistant: midpoint of v1 0.78 and v2a: less blue sky reflection at oblique angles, which is what makes the far river read slate blue
